caveats: All ten entries are law firms in East Brunswick, a single-category batch - the scores compare firms to each other, not to other industries.
Google review counts were often hidden by the 'limited view' Maps layout returned here; where a count is not shown it is marked as such rather than estimated.
Ratings and review counts are as displayed on 2026-11-12 and change frequently.
Ability-to-pay scores for law firms are inferences from office count, named staff, tenure and practice mix, since no firm publishes revenue.
Two entries have a website problem rather than a marketing problem: Ramatowski's domain no longer resolves and Nord & DeMaio's listed domain now serves unrelated gambling content.
Mayo Law's address on its own site and on Google is 743 Highway 18; the batch lists 43 Highway 18 - the batch entry appears to have dropped a digit.
data_gaps: Ramatowski, Spilka & Schwartz: no working website to review, and no review count or rating displayed on its Google listing; current attorney roster could not be confirmed beyond directory listings.

Antonelli Legal: the site is a Manhattan trusts-and-estates firm with no New Jersey content and no NJ Google listing; the 74 Brunswick Woods Drive, East Brunswick address appears only in third-party directories, so the actual East Brunswick entity remains unconfirmed.

Weiner & Weiner: HTTPS fails with a certificate error and the http:// host was blocked by the browser, so the page was read through a text fetch rather than in Chrome; schema markup and mobile rendering could not be checked.

Simon, Monahan & Simon: the entire site and its robots.txt sit behind a Cloudflare bot challenge; per instructions the challenge was not bypassed, so site content, forms, booking and schema are unverified.

Theodore Sliwinski: njaffordablelawyer.com returned HTTP 403 to Chrome from this network (it loaded through a text fetch), so the 403 may be IP/bot filtering rather than a customer-facing error; JSON-LD could not be checked in-browser.
No firm in this batch publishes price ranges except Sliwinski (flat fees); fee levels for the others are unknown.
Job postings were not checked for these firms; operations signals come from website features, practice mix and review-platform summaries only.
